content:
Apple TV has had a strong year so far, with its latest series Small Prophets being called the streamer's best premiere of 2026. Here's what critics are saying.

Small Prophets has received rave reviews, being labelled a 'masterpiece' for Apple TV.

Apple TV has had a stellar year for comedy, including new seasons of Shrinking, Ted Lasso and Trying, as well as original hit Widow's Bay – which swept the board at the Emmys.

Its latest comedy, Small Prophets, looks set to continue that hot streak.

Small Prophets premieres tonight at 9pm ET / 6pm PT, and critics have been full of praise.

We already knew Small Prophets was well-received, given it was one of the few shows Apple licensed out to other platforms. It aired earlier this year in the UK, and now Apple is bringing it to a global audience.

A fresh wave of reviews has cemented just how special Small Prophets is. It holds a 100% fresh rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Here's what The Hollywood Reporter said:

On top of that, the show has been called 'a gentle, gem-like, unhurried masterpiece', with one critic adding: 'the interweaving of the storylines is genius'.

So if you're after a great comedy to watch after tonight's Ted Lasso Season 4 finale, Apple has you covered.

Are you planning to watch Small Prophets? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 a month, and you can also get a discount through the Apple One bundle.
